question: Which of the following age groups is targeted under the Nurturing Aspirations through Vocational Training for Young Adolescent Girls programme, jointly launched by the Ministry of Women and Child Development and the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship in June 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**16 to 18 years**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Nurturing Aspirations through Vocational Training for Young Adolescent Girls** programme was launched in **June 2025** as a landmark collaborative initiative.
 
• This programme is a joint venture between the **Ministry of Women and Child Development (MWCD)** and the **Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE)**.
 
• The specific target demographic for this initiative is adolescent girls in the age group of **16 to 18 years**. This age bracket is considered critical as it marks the transition from secondary education to higher studies or entry into the workforce.
 
• The primary objective of the scheme is to provide **industry-relevant vocational training** to young girls, ensuring they possess the necessary skills to secure gainful employment or pursue entrepreneurship.
